personality_one_liner: A rustic, authentic Italian pizzeria feel delivered through a highly polished, iOS-native utility and community interface.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS-native rhythms. Content must be clearly grouped with comfortable vertical padding.

do's: Apply to sticky headers scrolling over feed content.
Apply to the bottom tab bar.
Apply to recipe card overlays using a gradient scrim if text overlaps the image.
dont's: Do not blur form inputs or calculator grid buttons.
Do not use blur on body text regions.

screens.name: CommunityFeed
screens.purpose: A scrollable wall to discover pizzas and recipes, acting as a 'Facebook for pizza'.

states.loading: Centered spinner over the sandy surface.
states.empty: Illustration of an empty pizza peel with a prompt to 'Bake your first pizza'.
states.error: Message 'Failed to load the wall' with a Retry button.

screens.layout: Vertical scroll feed. Use edge-to-edge full-width image cards for pizza posts, mimicking rich media layouts (Pinterest/Instagram). Overlay recipe title, hydration %, and author via a bottom-heavy gradient scrim. Actions (Like, Comment, Save) below the image or floating on it.

screens.name: CalculatorHub
screens.purpose: Multi-tool center for dough formulation, dimensions, and baking times.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders mimicking the iOS native grid list.
states.empty: Not applicable for the hub menu.

screens.layout: Grid or vertical list of tools (Dimensions, Dough & Fermentation, Home Baking). Inside the calculator, mirror native iOS grid/list components with clear numeric typography (Geist large), 44x44pt touch targets minimum, and bottom-pinned calculation CTA.

screens.name: Planner
screens.purpose: Reverse baking timeline planner with alarms.

states.empty: Illustration of a clock and dough resting, 'No active schedules'.

screens.layout: Timeline view using vertical connecting lines. Each step (Mixing, Bulk Ferment, Balling, Proofing, Baking) sits in a surfaceSecondary card. Provide quick 'Start Timer' actions via primary CTA.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Manage user equipment (ovens), saved recipes, and settings.
screens.layout: Standard iOS grouped list layout. A header with avatar (initials fallback if no image) over a blurred wood-fired oven background. Sections for Equipment, Saved Recipes, and App Settings (Multi-language).

hero_pizza.alt: Tasty Neapolitan pizza with melted cheese and sausage toppings

dough_making.alt: Hands kneading pizza dough on a floured surface

wood_fired_oven.alt: Pizza baking inside a classic wood-fired oven with visible flames

pizza_slice.alt: Close up of a pizza slice showing a beautiful airy cornicione

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 'iOS-Native Clean' personality with the warm terracotta (#D15900) brand color.
BANNED: Any shade of blue, purple, or indigo. Stick to warm earth tones, sandy background (#FAF5F0) and terracotta accents.
Implement the 'Community Feed' with large edge-to-edge media cards. ALWAYS use a top-down vertical gradient scrim (transparent -> 70% surfaceInverse) if text is placed over imagery.
In the 'CalculatorHub', prioritize usability: forms must have labels above inputs, and buttons should be large enough (44x44pt minimum) with generous padding.
For the 'Planner', ensure bottom-pinned primary CTAs over scrolling content are implemented, resting on a glass/blurred background container to prevent text clash.
Include high-contrast Loading/Empty/Error states for all data-fetching screens, occupying `flex: 1`.
Support dark mode natively by overriding surface to `#1C1917` and surfaceSecondary to `#292524`. Preserve the terracotta (#D15900) brand primary across both modes.
For Multi-language (HR, EN, DE), establish an internationalization structure early on but keep UI texts hardcoded into a constants object to make later extraction straightforward.
Incorporate haptics for calculator inputs and standard navigations as specified in the haptics block.
